notes.title: Patch v1.1 (10/01/2024)
notes.content:
Patch v1.1 Released on January 10th 2024.
Quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

[list]
-Reduced over sized collision boxes on multiple obstacles.

-Added background to "Credits" screen.

-Fixed "Level Complete!" screen opening on completion of Marathon Mode levels, causing issues with correct stats saving.

-Added "Clear Saves" button to "Options" menu, allowing users to clear their progress in the game.

-Removed Herobrine.
[/list]

notes.title: Day 0 Patch
notes.content: This Patch brings all content into the game.
